description.narrative: Country portfolio budget - CPB Ethiopia 2020-2025 Provide safe, nutritious and reliable daily meals to primary school children and support the Ministries and Bureaus of Education and Agriculture in scaling up nutrition-sensitive and gender equitable school feeding programmes.
